title: gypsophila gmelinii var. patrinii
intro: Gypsophila gmelinii var. patrinii, commonly known as Russian baby's breath, is a flowering plant in the family Caryophyllaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and alleviate anxiety due to its health benefits, including its sedative and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Russian baby's breath include its ability to induce sleep, calm the nervous system, and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
